name: The Present by Chema Méndez
tagline: 100-piece daily digital collage series on Verse, released in chapters of 5 artworks
description: A completed 100-artwork generative-art series by Spanish digital collage artist Chema Méndez (mendezmendez), hosted on Verse, an NFT art platform with a curatorial board. The series is a curation of his best daily pieces, presented in chapters of 5 artworks, with 1/1 holders receiving a monthly edition. As a design reference it is a dense, consistent body of surreal mixed-media work that blends Renaissance and classical painting with photography, 3D and AI imagery. Useful for art direction and moodboarding rather than for anything you can install.
pricing_detail: Free to browse. Artworks trade on secondary market: 100 items, 68 owners, $161,700 lifetime sales volume, highest sale $11,350 (ERC-721 on Ethereum, released 2024-05-23).
agent_guidance: Treat this as an art-direction moodboard source, never as a component or asset source — there is nothing to install and no license to reuse the imagery. Reach for it when a brief calls for surreal classical-meets-digital collage (Renaissance painting fused with 3D and AI elements) and you need a coherent 100-piece reference set rather than scattered single images. WebFetch gets a 403; a plain curl with a browser User-Agent returns server-rendered HTML with the series metadata, but the artwork grid itself is images only.
why_it_matters: A rare case of a complete, curated, 100-piece daily-practice series in one place, which makes it far more useful for establishing a visual direction than a scrolling social feed. It also documents the artist's most commercially validated body of work.
